J8-GAP-reclaim-redispatch-after-worker-d.note: lib/publish/postPublishClaim.ts reclaimStalePublishingQueueItems flips any publish_queue row left in 'publishing' for >15 min back to 'failed' with nextRetryAt=now, and processPublishQueue re-dispatches it in the same pass. Nothing records that the platform call already succeeded (no pre-dispatch 'dispatched' marker, no platform idempotency key), so a worker that dies (e.g. function timeout) after the adapter returned success but before the 'published' write sends the same post a second time. At-least-once delivery where the J8 contract requires at-most-once.
